_comment: C0-12 langflow bodies EN. 无附加小节。正文「相关条目」1 行带 .md 链接（flowise），related 写 1 条。

axes.model_access: Components connect to each vendor's LLMs/embeddings/vector stores; after the DataStax acquisition it is deeply integrated with their vector-database line (AstraDB); other provider coverage follows the official docs, not verified item by item.
axes.runtime: Open-source self-hosting (pip/uv/Docker) + the DataStax hosted line; GitHub 155,885★, last push 2026-10-21 (API-verified, very active).
axes.local_files: On a self-hosted instance, data, flow definitions and credentials all land in your own environment; official docs describe flow export/import mechanisms (details not verified item by item). The Cloud hosted line keeps data on DataStax's cloud.
axes.background: A continuously running self-hosted instance carries API serving and background execution; official deployment docs exist (details not verified item by item). "Keeps running when your laptop is off" depends on where you run the instance — the platform does not hold executions for you after shutdown.
axes.tools: Component marketplace + custom components are the official extension surface; MCP support status not verified item by item.
axes.context: In-flow state and memory components are the official context surface; cross-flow memory not verified item by item.
axes.permissions: Open-source edition has basic auth; enterprise governance comes with the DataStax hosted line — the open/commercial boundary not verified item by item.
axes.fit: Fits: an MIT-licensed LLM canvas, Python custom components, the DataStax stack. Does not fit: out-of-the-box enterprise governance (in the hosted line).

runs: This site has not completed measured runs. The closest test protocol is the code-side [protocols/framework/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/framework/_protocol.md) (the tool-calling and credential-boundary sections are reusable; no workflow-platform-specific protocol exists on this site yet).
unknowns:
- The full provider catalog (not verified item by item)
- MCP support status (no official documentation found)
- The feature boundary between the open-source edition and the DataStax hosted line (not verified item by item)
related: Both LLM canvases: MIT repo-wide vs Apache+ee mixed, DataStax enterprise line vs an independent company — license and ownership are the divides.
